name: Almutawa - Recycle Bin 24h Verifier
description: Hourly: a second AI agent checks soft-deleted items (and automation changes) after 24h against system errors since the change, then purges them or flags them and alerts the owner.

parameters.query: SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'table', table_name, 'row_id', row_id, 'reason', reason, 'deleted_by', deleted_by, 'deleted_at', deleted_at, 'data', left(data::text, 600)) ORDER BY id) AS items, min(deleted_at) AS since FROM (SELECT * FROM recycle_bin WHERE status = 'held' AND purge_after <= now() ORDER BY id LIMIT 20) b HAVING count(*) > 0

WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(id int, ok boolean, note text)), up AS (UPDATE recycle_bin b SET status = CASE WHEN v.ok THEN 'purged' ELSE 'flagged' END, data = CASE WHEN v.ok THEN jsonb_build_object('purged', true) ELSE b.data END, check_note = v.note, checked_at = now() FROM v WHERE b.id = v.id AND b.status = 'held' RETURNING b.id, b.table_name, b.row_id, b.status, b.check_note) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'purged') AS purged, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'flagged') AS flagged, coalesce(string_agg(CASE WHEN status = 'purged' THEN '✅ ' ELSE '⚠️ ' END || table_name || ' #' || row_id || ' (سلة ' || id || '): ' || coalesce(check_note, ''), E'\n'), '') AS lines FROM up

SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'table', table_name, 'row_id', row_id, 'reason', reason, 'deleted_by', deleted_by, 'deleted_at', deleted_at, 'data', left(data::text, 600)) ORDER BY id) AS items, min(deleted_at) AS since FROM (SELECT * FROM recycle_bin WHERE status = 'held' AND purge_after <= now() ORDER BY id LIMIT 20) b HAVING count(*) > 0

WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(id int, ok boolean, note text)), up AS (UPDATE recycle_bin b SET status = CASE WHEN v.ok THEN 'purged' ELSE 'flagged' END, data = CASE WHEN v.ok THEN jsonb_build_object('purged', true) ELSE b.data END, check_note = v.note, checked_at = now() FROM v WHERE b.id = v.id AND b.status = 'held' RETURNING b.id, b.table_name, b.row_id, b.status, b.check_note) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'purged') AS purged, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'flagged') AS flagged, coalesce(string_agg(CASE WHEN status = 'purged' THEN '✅ ' ELSE '⚠️ ' END || table_name || ' #' || row_id || ' (سلة ' || id || '): ' || coalesce(check_note, ''), E'\n'), '') AS lines FROM up
